question.text: A boy of mass $40 \mathrm{~kg}$ is climbing a vertical pole at a constant speed. If the coefficient of friction between his palms and the pole is 0.8 and $g=10 \mathrm{~m} / \mathrm{s}^2$, the horizontal force that he is applying on the pole is

solution.text:
Hints: Here $\mu=0.8$
Frictional force $=\mu \mathrm{N}_1=m g$
$$
\mathrm{N}_1=\frac{m g}{\mu}=\frac{400}{0.8}=500 \mathrm{~N}
$$
